content_direction.premise: Marta is new to everyday life in Germany; she and her flatmate Lukas solve relatable problems with warm situational comedy.
content_direction.teaching: One useful German phrase or distinction per episode, taught through visible objects and actions.
content_direction.continuity: Recurring adult characters, coherent daily situations, short comic payoff and a playful bridge to the next episode.
content_direction.credit_policy: Explicit owner instruction required for each new credit-funded production; previous sample permissions do not carry over.
